name: Medication Heavy Dictation
description: Physician dictation focusing on multiple medication orders with complex dosing

transcript.rawText: Patient is a 65 year old male with history of hypertension type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease stage 3. Blood pressure readings have been elevated at 165 over 95 on home monitoring. Starting the following medications. Amlodipine 5 milligrams once daily for blood pressure. Metformin 500 milligrams twice daily before meals for diabetes control. Atorvastatin 40 milligrams at bedtime for lipid management. Also continuing Telmisartan 40 milligrams once daily. For kidney protection and blood pressure. Patient to follow up in 2 weeks for blood pressure check and renal function tests. No known drug allergies. Patient advised to take medications strictly as prescribed and report any side effects especially dizziness or muscle pain.
